verdict.rationale: Morph is an inference and model API: an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, Fast Apply, WarpGrep, Compact and Reflex classifiers. An in-product insights feature is plausible for this kind of platform, but the evidence documents none. Reflexes (e.g., labeling user frustration or stuck-in-a-loop turns) are API classifiers a developer would call and build on, which are building blocks rather than insights surfaced inside the product. The canary's Reflex comparison is an adjacent migration-gating feature, not AI-generated insights or suggestions about the user's data.
